title: add-rag-agent-templates-tool-calling-quickstarts-and-docs-update
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: provide standardized RAG agent templates and tool-calling examples to speed developer onboarding and reduce integration errors. This PR adds a set of opinionated RAG templates (single-file and orchestrated examples), three tool-calling agent quickstarts (Python/TS/Go), updated example datasets, and docs site updates that consolidate the agent quickstarts and show recommended prompt and cache settings.

What this includes: updated redwood-examples/rag templates (retrieval-configs, template prompts, and example corpus), three quickstart projects under redwood-examples/quickstarts/agents (python, typescript, go) with runnable examples and README steps, docs changes under site/docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-quickstarts.md and reference updates to docs/reference/agents.md, and snippets added to redwood-sdk-python and redwood-sdk-typescript examples showing tool registration and typed function calls.

Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates and retrieval configs - [x] Add tool-calling quickstarts for Python/TS/Go - [x] Update docs site quickstarts and reference pages - [x] Add CI example runs for quickstarts - [x] Add integration test that boots the example agent in CI with a tiny corpus

Testing notes: local smoke tested the three quickstarts end-to-end using the small test corpus (included), ran unit tests for the examples, and validated the docs build locally. CI runs include a docs-site build, lints, and an example quickstart smoke test using mocked model endpoints.

Related: closes ENG-2987, references ENG-3012 (agent-evals), and PM-142 for product review. See changelog/release notes below for user-facing highlights.
